item.tib: lam sgrub kyi yig chung gnad sgron mdzes pa'i zur rgyan
item.coloph: brtsams tshul ni/ gangs can 'gro ba'i gtsug gi nor bu'i tog rgyal bstan nyin mor byed pa'i gnyen gcig po/ rin chen 'od kyis spyi spungs cha lag sogs/ ud pal tshal chen rgyas kyang 'dir ma smin/ de tshe ldum ra'i yal ga la 'bad nas/ pad tshal bskyed blo cal col rtsom pa po/ rgyal ba tshul zhes 'bod pa ang ster mkhan/ gang des rnam g.yeng la bros ri bo'i mgor/ dben pa'i gnas su sbyar bas bdag 'dra yi/ blo chung rjes 'jug rna ba'i rgyan cha ru/ dbang chen sgrub la mos blos rtag tu mchong (chongs)/ dge des rgyal bstan zhabs nas 'degs gyur cig/
